<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Fout'Agro</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#16233d">
<link rel="icon" href="logo.jpg" type="image/jpeg">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="logo.jpg">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Fout'Agro">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#1c3d2e; --ink-2:#2f5c46; --paper:#faf6ec; --card:#ffffff;
  --line:#e6ddc4; --muted:#77715f; --gold:#d99a2b; --gold-2:#b97e1f;
  --paid:#2f6d52; --due:#a8452b;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --ink:#eef0f4; --ink-2:#a9d6bd; --paper:#0f1712; --card:#182620;
    --line:#2a3b31; --muted:#9aa89e; --gold:#e6b04d; --gold-2:#d99a2b; --paid:#5fbf94; --due:#e07356;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --ink:#eef0f4; --ink-2:#a9d6bd; --paper:#0f1712; --card:#182620;
  --line:#2a3b31; --muted:#9aa89e; --gold:#e6b04d; --gold-2:#d99a2b; --paid:#5fbf94; --due:#e07356;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{height:100%;}
body{
  margin:0; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink);
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
header{
  position:sticky; top:0; top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink) 0%, var(--ink-2) 130%);
  color:#fff; padding:20px 20px;
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px 28px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  z-index:10; border-bottom:3px solid var(--gold);
}
.brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
.brand img{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; display:block;}
header h1{font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:700; margin:0; letter-spacing:.2px;}
.totals{display:flex; gap:22px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.totals div{text-align:right;}
.totals .label{font-size:.68rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.65); margin:0;}
.totals .value{font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; margin:0; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.totals .paid .value{color:#a9e6c4;}
.totals .due .value{color:#f3c98a;}

main{max-width:720px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px 16px 60px;}

.card{
  background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px;
  padding:18px; margin-bottom:16px; border-top:3px solid var(--gold);
}
.card h2{font-size:1rem; margin:0 0 4px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink);}
.card .sub{font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 14px;}

/* Catalogue */
.catalogue{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr)); gap:10px;}
.cat-item{
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--paper);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.cat-item .img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:1/1; object-fit:cover; background:var(--line);}
.cat-item .ph-icon{width:100%; aspect-ratio:1/1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:2rem; background:var(--line);}
.cat-item .info{padding:8px; text-align:center;}
.cat-item .nm{font-size:.76rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.15;}
.cat-item .pr{font-size:.78rem; color:var(--gold-2); font-weight:700; margin-top:2px;}

/* Dashboard */
.stats-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:10px;}
.stat-box{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; padding:12px; border-left:3px solid var(--gold);}
.stat-box .num{font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--ink);}
.stat-box .lbl{font-size:.75rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px;}
#chartWrap{margin-top:16px;}
#chartWrap canvas{width:100%; height:180px; display:block;}
.chart-empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:.85rem; text-align:center; padding:20px 0;}

/* Simple registration form */
.reg-form{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:end;}
.reg-form .field{flex:1; min-width:140px;}
label{display:block; font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:4px;}
input,select{
  width:100%; padding:9px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px;
  background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); font-size:.95rem;
}
input:focus,select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:1px;}
button{
  cursor:pointer; border:none; border-radius:7px; padding:10px 16px;
  font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--gold); color:#1c1305; font-weight:700;}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--gold-2);}

.pkg-picker{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:10px 0;}
.pkg-choice{
  border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:8px 10px; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; width:92px;
  background:var(--paper); text-align:center;
}
.pkg-choice img{width:48px; height:48px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;}
.pkg-choice .ph{width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--line); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.4rem;}
.pkg-choice .nm{font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.1;}
.pkg-choice .pr{font-size:.68rem; color:var(--muted);}
.pkg-choice.selected{border-color:var(--gold); background:rgba(217,154,43,.12);}
.pkg-choice.manual{justify-content:center;}

.pkg-row{display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:end; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pkg-row input[type="text"],.pkg-row input[type="number"]{flex:1; min-width:100px;}
.pkg-row input[type="file"]{flex:1; min-width:140px; font-size:.78rem; padding:6px;}
.small-btn{background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); padding:9px 12px;}
.small-btn:hover{color:var(--ink); border-color:var(--muted);}

.pkg-card{
  display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px; background:var(--paper);
}
.pkg-card img{width:32px; height:32px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px;}
.pkg-card .rmPkg{background:none;border:none;color:var(--due);cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-size:1rem;}

.search-box{margin-bottom:12px;}

.client{
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:12px;
  background:var(--card);
}
.client-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; align-items:center;}
.client-top strong{font-size:1.02rem;}
.client-top .date{font-size:.74rem; color:var(--muted);}

.purchase{
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:10px; margin-top:10px; background:var(--paper);
}
.purchase-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:8px;}
.purchase-top .pname{font-weight:600; font-size:.85rem;}

.progress-wrap{margin-top:8px;}
.progress-bar{width:100%; height:9px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--line); overflow:hidden;}
.progress-fill{height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--paid) 100%); border-radius:6px; transition:width .3s ease;}
.progress-label{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px;}
.progress-label b{color:var(--ink); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

.purchase-actions{margin-top:8px; display:flex; gap:8px;}
.purchase-actions button{padding:5px 9px; font-size:.72rem;}
.del{background:transparent; color:var(--due); border:1px solid var(--line);}
.pay{background:transparent; color:var(--paid); border:1px solid var(--line);}

.add-purchase-btn{
  margin-top:10px; width:100%; background:transparent; border:1.5px dashed var(--gold);
  color:var(--gold-2); font-weight:600; padding:8px;
}
.add-purchase-btn:hover{background:rgba(217,154,43,.08);}

.add-purchase-form{
  margin-top:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; background:var(--paper);
  display:none;
}
.add-purchase-form.open{display:block;}
.add-purchase-form .row{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:8px;}
.add-purchase-form .row > div{flex:1; min-width:110px;}
.add-purchase-form .actions{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;}
.sel-row{border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:8px; margin-top:8px; background:var(--card);}
.sel-row-top{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; font-size:.85rem;}
.rm-sel{background:none; border:none; color:var(--due); cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:.95rem;}
.sel-row .row{margin-top:6px;}
.cancel-btn{background:transparent; color:var(--muted); border:1px solid var(--line);}

.del-client{background:transparent; color:var(--due); border:none; font-size:.85rem; cursor:pointer;}

.empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:.88rem; text-align:center; padding:24px 0;}

.wa-btn{display:inline-block; background:#25D366; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; border-radius:7px; padding:5px 9px; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600;}
.pay-hist{margin-top:8px; border-top:1px dashed var(--line); padding-top:6px;}
.hist-line{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); padding:2px 0;}
.hist-line b{color:var(--paid); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.pay-form{margin-top:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:10px; background:var(--card); display:none;}
.pay-form.open{display:block;}
.pay-form .row{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pay-form .row > div{flex:1; min-width:110px;}
.pay-form .actions{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:8px;}
.client-tools{margin-top:8px; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;}
.purchase-actions{flex-wrap:wrap;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="brand">
    <img src="logo.jpg" alt="Fout'Agro">
    <h1>Fout'Agro</h1>
  </div>
  <div class="totals">
    <div class="paid"><p class="label">Revenus encaissés</p><p class="value" id="totalPaid">0</p></div>
    <div class="due"><p class="label">Restant à percevoir</p><p class="value" id="totalDue">0</p></div>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <div class="card">
    <h2>Tableau de bord</h2>
    <div class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat-box"><div class="num" id="statClients">0</div><div class="lbl">Clients</div></div>
      <div class="stat-box"><div class="num" id="statPaquetsVendus">0</div><div class="lbl">Paquets en cours</div></div>
      <div class="stat-box"><div class="num" id="statTotalVentes">0</div><div class="lbl">Total des ventes</div></div>
      <div class="stat-box"><div class="num" id="statMoyenne">0</div><div class="lbl">Panier moyen</div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="chartWrap">
      <canvas id="chartCanvas"></canvas>
      <div class="chart-empty" id="chartEmpty" style="display:none;">Ajoute des paquets à un client pour voir le graphique</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>Inscrire un client</h2>
    <p class="sub">Le paquet sera choisi juste après, une fois le client inscrit</p>
    <form id="clientForm" class="reg-form">
      <div class="field">
        <label>Nom du client</label>
        <input type="text" id="cName" required>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Téléphone</label>
        <input type="tel" id="cPhone" placeholder="77 123 45 67">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Date</label>
        <input type="date" id="cDate">
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-primary">Inscrire</button>
    </form>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px;">
      <h2 style="margin:0;">Clients</h2>
      <button class="small-btn" id="exportCsv">⬇ Exporter CSV</button>
    </div>
    <input type="text" id="searchClient" class="search-box" placeholder="Rechercher un client...">
    <div id="clientList"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>Catalogue des paquets</h2>
    <p class="sub">Les produits disponibles à la vente</p>
    <div class="catalogue" id="catalogue"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <h2>Gérer les paquets</h2>
    <p class="sub">Ajoute, modifie ou retire un produit du catalogue</p>
    <div class="pkg-row">
      <input type="text" id="pkgName" placeholder="Nom du paquet">
      <input type="number" id="pkgPrice" placeholder="Prix" step="0.01">
      <input type="file" id="pkgPhoto" accept="image/*">
      <button class="small-btn" id="addPkg">Ajouter</button>
    </div>
    <div id="pkgList" style="margin-top:10px; display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;"></div>
  </div>
</main>

<script>
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
let packages = [];
let clients = []; // {id, name, date, purchases:[{package, price, paid, date}]}
let openAddFor = null; // client id currently showing "add purchase" form
let selectedPkgs = {}; // per client id, array of selected keys ('manual' or package index as string)

function uid(){ return 'c'+Date.now()+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2); }

function svgIcon(type){
  if(type==='bissap'){
    return 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(`
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="200" height="200" fill="#eef6ec"/>
<g transform="translate(100,95)">
<ellipse rx="46" ry="26" fill="#c02d5e" transform="rotate(0)"/>
<ellipse rx="46" ry="26" fill="#d1447a" transform="rotate(72)"/>
<ellipse rx="46" ry="26" fill="#c02d5e" transform="rotate(144)"/>
<ellipse rx="46" ry="26" fill="#d1447a" transform="rotate(216)"/>
<ellipse rx="46" ry="26" fill="#c02d5e" transform="rotate(288)"/>
<circle r="14" fill="#7a1f3a"/>
</g>
<path d="M70 145 Q100 170 130 145 Q100 158 70 145Z" fill="#3d7a4a"/>
<path d="M100 40 L100 70" stroke="#3d7a4a" stroke-width="4"/>
</svg>`);
  }
  if(type==='laitue'){
    return 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(`
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="200" height="200" fill="#f7f4e6"/>
<path d="M100 40 C60 45 35 75 35 110 C35 145 65 165 100 165 C135 165 165 145 165 110 C165 75 140 45 100 40Z" fill="#6fae4f"/>
<path d="M100 55 C70 60 50 82 50 108 C50 136 72 150 100 150 C128 150 150 136 150 108 C150 82 130 60 100 55Z" fill="#8fc766"/>
<path d="M100 70 C80 74 66 88 66 106 C66 126 82 136 100 136 C118 136 134 126 134 106 C134 88 120 74 100 70Z" fill="#a9d97f"/>
</svg>`);
  }
  if(type==='oignon'){
    return 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + encodeURIComponent(`
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="200" height="200" fill="#f7f0e8"/>
<path d="M100 150 Q60 150 58 108 Q56 70 100 48 Q144 70 142 108 Q140 150 100 150Z" fill="#e7d6e6"/>
<path d="M100 145 Q68 145 66 108 Q65 76 100 58" fill="none" stroke="#b98cbf" stroke-width="3"/>
<path d="M100 145 Q132 145 134 108 Q135 76 100 58" fill="none" stroke="#b98cbf" stroke-width="3"/>
<path d="M100 48 L96 30" stroke="#4c8a4f" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M100 48 L106 28" stroke="#6fae4f" stroke-width="4"/>
</svg>`);
  }
  return '';
}

const DEFAULT_PACKAGES = [
  {name:'Bissap blanc 100g + 2kg NPK', price:5000, photo:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
  {name:'Laitue 5g + 2kg NPK', price:5000, photo:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
  {name:'Oignon 10g + 2kg NPK', price:6000, photo:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'},
  {name:'Paquet poule (1 mâle + 2 femelles)', price:8000, photo:'data:image/jpeg;base64,'}
];

// Une seule fois : met les nouvelles photos sur les paquets existants (Laitue, Oignon, Poule)
function migratePackagePhotos(){
  let ver = null;
  try{ ver = localStorage.getItem('sc_pkg_ver'); }catch(e){}
  if(ver==='4') return;
  const rules = [{re:/bissap/i, def:DEFAULT_PACKAGES[0]}];
  if(ver!=='3'){
    rules.push({re:/laitue/i, def:DEFAULT_PACKAGES[1]});
    rules.push({re:/oignon/i, def:DEFAULT_PACKAGES[2]});
    rules.push({re:/poule/i,  def:DEFAULT_PACKAGES[3]});
  }
  rules.forEach(r=>{
    const found = packages.filter(p=>r.re.test(p.name));
    if(found.length){ found.forEach(p=>{ p.photo = r.def.photo; }); }
    else if(r.def===DEFAULT_PACKAGES[3]){ packages.push(Object.assign({}, r.def)); }
  });
  savePackages();
  try{ localStorage.setItem('sc_pkg_ver','4'); }catch(e){}
}

function load(){
  try{ packages = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sc_packages')||'[]'); }catch(e){ packages=[]; }
  try{ clients = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sc_clients_v2')||'[]'); }catch(e){ clients=[]; }
  if(packages.length===0){
    packages = DEFAULT_PACKAGES.map(p=>Object.assign({}, p));
    savePackages();
  }
  migratePackagePhotos();
  // Migration from old single-package client format if present
  if(clients.length===0){
    try{
      const old = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sc_clients')||'[]');
      if(old.length){
        clients = old.map(c=>({
          id: uid(), name:c.name, date:c.date,
          purchases:[{package:c.package, price:c.price, paid:c.paid, date:c.date}]
        }));
        saveClients();
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
}
function savePackages(){ try{ localStorage.setItem('sc_packages', JSON.stringify(packages)); }catch(e){} }
function saveClients(){ try{ localStorage.setItem('sc_clients_v2', JSON.stringify(clients)); }catch(e){} }

function fmt(n){ return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('fr-FR',{minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2}); }

function resizeImage(file, maxSize, callback){
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){
      let w = img.width, h = img.height;
      if(w > h){ if(w > maxSize){ h = Math.round(h*maxSize/w); w = maxSize; } }
      else { if(h > maxSize){ w = Math.round(w*maxSize/h); h = maxSize; } }
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      callback(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7));
    };
    img.src = e.target.result;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function renderCatalogue(){
  const cat = $('catalogue');
  if(packages.length===0){
    cat.innerHTML = '<p class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1;">Aucun paquet pour l’instant.</p>';
    return;
  }
  cat.innerHTML = packages.map(p=>`
    <div class="cat-item">
      ${p.photo?`<img class="img" src="${p.photo}" alt="${p.name}">`:'<div class="ph-icon">📦</div>'}
      <div class="info">
        <div class="nm">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="pr">${fmt(p.price)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function renderPkgManage(){
  $('pkgList').innerHTML = packages.map((p,i)=>
    `<span class="pkg-card">
      ${p.photo?`<img src="${p.photo}" alt="${p.name}">`:''}
      ${p.name} — ${fmt(p.price)}
      <button data-i="${i}" class="rmPkg">✕</button>
    </span>`).join('') || '<span class="empty" style="padding:0;">Aucun paquet</span>';
  document.querySelectorAll('.rmPkg').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    packages.splice(+b.dataset.i,1);
    savePackages(); renderAll();
  });
}

function drawChart(){
  const canvas = $('chartCanvas');
  const emptyMsg = $('chartEmpty');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const cssW = canvas.clientWidth || canvas.parentElement.clientWidth;
  const cssH = 180;
  canvas.width = cssW*dpr; canvas.height = cssH*dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cssW,cssH);

  const totals = {};
  clients.forEach(c=>{
    (c.purchases||[]).forEach(p=>{
      const key = p.package || 'Manuel';
      totals[key] = (totals[key]||0) + Number(p.price||0);
    });
  });
  const labels = Object.keys(totals);
  if(labels.length===0){
    canvas.style.display='none'; emptyMsg.style.display='block'; return;
  }
  canvas.style.display='block'; emptyMsg.style.display='none';

  const values = labels.map(l=>totals[l]);
  const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);
  const barColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--gold').trim() || '#d99a2b';
  const textColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--ink').trim() || '#1c3d2e';
  const mutedColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--muted').trim() || '#77715f';

  const padTop = 10, padBottom = 34, padSide = 8;
  const chartH = cssH - padTop - padBottom;
  const n = labels.length;
  const gap = 14;
  const barW = Math.min(56, (cssW - padSide*2 - gap*(n-1)) / n);
  const totalW = barW*n + gap*(n-1);
  let x = (cssW - totalW)/2;

  ctx.font = '11px -apple-system, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';

  values.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const h = maxVal>0 ? (v/maxVal)*chartH : 0;
    const y = padTop + (chartH - h);
    ctx.fillStyle = barColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(ctx.roundRect){ ctx.roundRect(x, y, barW, h, 6); } else { ctx.rect(x,y,barW,h); }
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = mutedColor;
    ctx.fillText(fmt(v), x + barW/2, y - 4 < 10 ? 10 : y - 4);

    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    const label = labels[i].length > 10 ? labels[i].slice(0,9)+'…' : labels[i];
    ctx.fillText(label, x + barW/2, cssH - padBottom + 16);

    x += barW + gap;
  });
}

function allPurchases(){
  const out = [];
  clients.forEach(c=>(c.purchases||[]).forEach(p=>out.push(p)));
  return out;
}

function renderDashboard(){
  const purchases = allPurchases();
  $('statClients').textContent = clients.length;
  $('statPaquetsVendus').textContent = purchases.filter(p=>(p.price-p.paid)>0).length;
  const totalVentes = purchases.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.price||0),0);
  $('statTotalVentes').textContent = fmt(totalVentes);
  const moyenne = purchases.length ? totalVentes/purchases.length : 0;
  $('statMoyenne').textContent = fmt(moyenne);
  drawChart();

  const totalPaid = purchases.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.paid||0),0);
  const totalDue = purchases.reduce((s,p)=>s+Math.max(p.price-p.paid,0),0);
  $('totalPaid').textContent = fmt(totalPaid);
  $('totalDue').textContent = fmt(totalDue);
}

function pkgPickerHtml(clientId){
  const sel = selectedPkgs[clientId] || [];
  let html = `<div class="pkg-choice manual${sel.includes('manual')?' selected':''}" data-i="manual">
      <div class="ph">✎</div><div class="nm">Manuel</div></div>`;
  html += packages.map((p,i)=>`
    <div class="pkg-choice${sel.includes(String(i))?' selected':''}" data-i="${i}">
      ${p.photo?`<img src="${p.photo}" alt="${p.name}">`:'<div class="ph">📦</div>'}
      <div class="nm">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="pr">${fmt(p.price)}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  return html;
}

function selectedRowsHtml(clientId){
  const sel = selectedPkgs[clientId] || [];
  const methodOpts = METHODS.map(m=>'<option>'+m+'</option>').join('');
  if(sel.length===0) return '<p class="empty" style="padding:6px 0;">Choisis un ou plusieurs paquets ci-dessus.</p>';
  return sel.map(key=>{
    const isManual = key==='manual';
    const pkg = isManual ? null : packages[+key];
    const name = isManual ? 'Manuel' : pkg.name;
    const defPrice = isManual ? '' : pkg.price;
    return `<div class="sel-row" data-selkey="${key}">
      <div class="sel-row-top"><b>${name}</b><button type="button" class="rm-sel" data-cid="${clientId}" data-selkey="${key}">✕</button></div>
      <div class="row">
        <div><label>Prix</label><input type="number" step="1" class="row-price" value="${defPrice}"></div>
        <div><label>Déjà versé</label><input type="number" step="1" class="row-paid" value="0"></div>
        <div><label>Moyen</label><select class="row-method">${methodOpts}</select></div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

const METHODS = ['Espèces','Wave','Orange Money','Autre'];
let openPayFor = null;

function esc(s){
  return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
}
function fmtF(n){ return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('fr-FR',{maximumFractionDigits:0}) + ' FCFA'; }
function today(){ return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }

function recalc(p){
  p.paid = (p.payments||[]).reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.amount||0),0);
}
function ensurePayments(){
  clients.forEach(c=>(c.purchases||[]).forEach(p=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(p.payments)){
      p.payments = Number(p.paid)>0 ? [{amount:Number(p.paid), date:p.date||'', method:'Espèces'}] : [];
    }
    recalc(p);
  }));
}

function waLink(phone, msg){
  let d = (phone||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if(d.length===9) d = '221'+d;
  return 'https://wa.me/'+d+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg);
}
function clientMsg(c){
  const ps = c.purchases||[];
  const total = ps.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.price||0),0);
  const paid = ps.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.paid||0),0);
  const rest = Math.max(total-paid,0);
  let m = 'Bonjour '+c.name+', voici votre situation Fout\'Agro :\n';
  ps.forEach(p=>{ m += '- '+p.package+' : '+fmtF(p.paid)+' / '+fmtF(p.price)+'\n'; });
  m += 'Total : '+fmtF(total)+'\nDéjà payé : '+fmtF(paid)+'\nReste à payer : '+fmtF(rest)+'\nMerci pour votre confiance.';
  return m;
}
function receiptMsg(c,p){
  const rest = Math.max(p.price-p.paid,0);
  return 'REÇU FOUT\'AGRO\nClient : '+c.name+'\nProduit : '+p.package+'\nPrix : '+fmtF(p.price)+'\nPayé : '+fmtF(p.paid)+'\nReste : '+fmtF(rest)+'\nDate : '+(p.date||today())+'\nMerci pour votre confiance.';
}

function exportCSV(){
  const rows = [['Client','Téléphone','Paquet','Prix','Payé','Reste','Date']];
  clients.forEach(c=>(c.purchases||[]).forEach(p=>{
    rows.push([c.name, c.phone||'', p.package, p.price, p.paid, Math.max(p.price-p.paid,0), p.date||'']);
  }));
  const csv = '\ufeff' + rows.map(r=>r.map(v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(';')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'fout-agro-clients.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
}

function renderClients(filter){
  const list = $('clientList');
  const term = (filter||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = term ? clients.filter(c=>c.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) || (c.phone||'').includes(term)) : clients;

  if(clients.length===0){
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="empty">Aucun client inscrit pour l’instant.</p>';
    return;
  }
  if(filtered.length===0){
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="empty">Aucun client ne correspond à la recherche.</p>';
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = filtered.map(c=>{
    const purchasesHtml = (c.purchases||[]).map((p,pi)=>{
      const remaining = p.price - p.paid;
      const pct = p.price>0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((p.paid/p.price)*100)) : 0;
      const key = c.id+':'+pi;
      const payOpen = openPayFor===key;
      const hist = (p.payments||[]).map(x=>
        '<div class="hist-line"><span>'+esc(x.date||'')+' · '+esc(x.method||'')+'</span><b>+'+fmt(x.amount)+'</b></div>'
      ).join('');
      const methodOpts = METHODS.map(m=>'<option>'+m+'</option>').join('');
      return `<div class="purchase">
        <div class="purchase-top">
          <span class="pname">${esc(p.package||'Manuel')}</span>
          <span class="date">${esc(p.date||'')}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress-wrap">
          <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%;"></div></div>
          <div class="progress-label"><span>${pct}% versé</span><b>${fmt(p.paid)} / ${fmt(p.price)}</b></div>
        </div>
        ${hist?`<div class="pay-hist">${hist}</div>`:''}
        <div class="purchase-actions">
          ${remaining>0?`<button class="pay" data-key="${key}" data-action="togglePay">+ Versement</button>`:''}
          ${remaining>0?`<button class="pay" data-cid="${c.id}" data-pi="${pi}" data-action="solder">Solder</button>`:''}
          <a class="wa-btn" href="${waLink(c.phone, receiptMsg(c,p))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📲 Reçu</a>
          <button class="del" data-cid="${c.id}" data-pi="${pi}" data-action="delp">Supprimer</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pay-form${payOpen?' open':''}">
          <div class="row">
            <div><label>Montant versé</label><input type="number" step="1" id="payamt-${c.id}-${pi}"></div>
            <div><label>Moyen de paiement</label><select id="paymethod-${c.id}-${pi}">${methodOpts}</select></div>
          </div>
          <div class="actions">
            <button class="btn-primary" data-cid="${c.id}" data-pi="${pi}" data-action="savePay">Enregistrer</button>
            <button class="cancel-btn" data-action="cancelPay">Annuler</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') || '<p class="empty" style="padding:8px 0;">Aucun paquet ajouté pour ce client.</p>';

    const isOpen = openAddFor === c.id;

    return `<div class="client">
      <div class="client-top">
        <strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong>
        <button class="del-client" data-cid="${c.id}" data-action="delclient">✕ Supprimer client</button>
      </div>
      <div class="date">Inscrit le ${esc(c.date||'')}${c.phone?` · 📞 ${esc(c.phone)}`:''}</div>
      <div class="client-tools">
        <a class="wa-btn" href="${waLink(c.phone, clientMsg(c))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📲 Envoyer la situation</a>
      </div>
      ${purchasesHtml}
      <button class="add-purchase-btn" data-cid="${c.id}" data-action="toggleAdd">+ Ajouter un paquet</button>
      <div class="add-purchase-form${isOpen?' open':''}" id="addForm-${c.id}">
        <label>Choisir un ou plusieurs paquets</label>
        <div class="pkg-picker" id="pkgPicker-${c.id}">${pkgPickerHtml(c.id)}</div>
        <div id="selRows-${c.id}">${selectedRowsHtml(c.id)}</div>
        <div class="actions">
          <button class="btn-primary" data-cid="${c.id}" data-action="savePurchase">Enregistrer</button>
          <button class="cancel-btn" data-cid="${c.id}" data-action="cancelAdd">Annuler</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const rerender = ()=>renderClients($('searchClient').value);

  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="toggleAdd"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const cid = b.dataset.cid;
    openAddFor = (openAddFor === cid) ? null : cid;
    if(openAddFor) selectedPkgs[cid] = selectedPkgs[cid] || [];
    rerender();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="cancelAdd"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    openAddFor = null; rerender();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="togglePay"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    openPayFor = (openPayFor===b.dataset.key) ? null : b.dataset.key;
    rerender();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="cancelPay"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    openPayFor = null; rerender();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="savePay"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const cid = b.dataset.cid, pi = +b.dataset.pi;
    const c = clients.find(c=>c.id===cid);
    const p = c.purchases[pi];
    let amount = parseFloat($('payamt-'+cid+'-'+pi).value)||0;
    const remaining = p.price - p.paid;
    if(amount<=0) return;
    if(amount>remaining) amount = remaining;
    p.payments.push({amount, date:today(), method:$('paymethod-'+cid+'-'+pi).value});
    recalc(p);
    saveClients();
    openPayFor = null;
    renderAll();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="solder"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const c = clients.find(c=>c.id===b.dataset.cid);
    const p = c.purchases[+b.dataset.pi];
    const remaining = p.price - p.paid;
    if(remaining>0){
      p.payments.push({amount:remaining, date:today(), method:'Espèces'});
      recalc(p); saveClients(); renderAll();
    }
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="delclient"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    if(!confirm('Supprimer ce client et tous ses paquets ?')) return;
    clients = clients.filter(c=>c.id!==b.dataset.cid);
    saveClients(); renderAll();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="delp"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    if(!confirm('Supprimer ce paquet ?')) return;
    const c = clients.find(c=>c.id===b.dataset.cid);
    c.purchases.splice(+b.dataset.pi,1);
    saveClients(); renderAll();
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('[data-action="savePurchase"]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const cid = b.dataset.cid;
    const c = clients.find(c=>c.id===cid);
    const container = document.getElementById('selRows-'+cid);
    const rows = container ? container.querySelectorAll('.sel-row') : [];
    if(rows.length===0) return;
    const date = today();
    c.purchases = c.purchases || [];
    rows.forEach(row=>{
      const key = row.dataset.selkey;
      const isManual = key==='manual';
      const pkgName = isManual ? 'Manuel' : packages[+key].name;
      let price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.row-price').value)||0;
      let paid = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.row-paid').value)||0;
      const method = row.querySelector('.row-method').value;
      if(price<=0) return;
      if(paid>price) paid = price;
      c.purchases.push({
        package:pkgName, price, paid, date,
        payments: paid>0 ? [{amount:paid, date, method}] : []
      });
    });
    saveClients();
    openAddFor = null;
    delete selectedPkgs[cid];
    renderAll();
  });

  clients.forEach(c=>{
    const picker = document.getElementById('pkgPicker-'+c.id);
    if(!picker) return;
    picker.querySelectorAll('.pkg-choice').forEach(el=>{
      el.onclick = ()=>{
        const key = el.dataset.i;
        const arr = selectedPkgs[c.id] || (selectedPkgs[c.id] = []);
        const at = arr.indexOf(key);
        if(at>=0) arr.splice(at,1); else arr.push(key);
        rerender();
      };
    });
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('.rm-sel').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
    const cid = b.dataset.cid, key = b.dataset.selkey;
    const arr = selectedPkgs[cid] || [];
    const at = arr.indexOf(key);
    if(at>=0) arr.splice(at,1);
    rerender();
  });
}

function renderAll(){
  renderCatalogue();
  renderPkgManage();
  renderClients($('searchClient') ? $('searchClient').value : '');
  renderDashboard();
}

$('searchClient').addEventListener('input', e=>{
  renderClients(e.target.value);
});

$('clientForm').addEventListener('submit', e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const name = $('cName').value.trim();
  if(!name) return;
  const newClient = {
    id: uid(),
    name,
    phone: $('cPhone').value.trim(),
    date: $('cDate').value || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),
    purchases: []
  };
  clients.push(newClient);
  saveClients();
  e.target.reset();
  openAddFor = newClient.id;
  selectedPkgs[newClient.id] = [];
  renderAll();
  const el = document.getElementById('addForm-'+newClient.id);
  if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});
});

$('addPkg').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  const name = $('pkgName').value.trim();
  const price = parseFloat($('pkgPrice').value);
  const fileInput = $('pkgPhoto');
  if(!name || isNaN(price)) return;
  if(fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]){
    resizeImage(fileInput.files[0], 300, (dataUrl)=>{
      packages.push({name, price, photo: dataUrl});
      savePackages();
      $('pkgName').value=''; $('pkgPrice').value=''; fileInput.value='';
      renderAll();
    });
  } else {
    packages.push({name, price, photo:''});
    savePackages();
    $('pkgName').value=''; $('pkgPrice').value='';
    renderAll();
  }
});

$('exportCsv').addEventListener('click', exportCSV);

window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{ drawChart(); });

load();
ensurePayments();
renderAll();

if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
  window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('service-worker.js').catch(()=>{});
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
